headline: Ternary Witt and rank-three rigidity research
claimBoundary: This site does not claim a completed counterexample to Connes's rigidity conjecture. Finite verification, Lean source, a green full build, and expert review are distinct evidence states.

claims.name: Canonical Hopf structure reconstructs the group
claims.evidence: Classical theorem direction with Lean source present. The standalone group-algebra bridge is in the current full-build audit.

claims.name: Rank-three divided-cube transvection orbit is infinite
claims.evidence: Strongest plausible novelty candidate. The exponent-separation proof architecture is present; promotion waits for a green dependency graph and expert review.

claims.name: Divided cube and Frobenius kernel are cyclic modules
claims.evidence: Julia verified truncations N=1..4: pure-cube orbit spans all of B, the all-distinct tensor spans ker d3, and the common fixed subspace is zero. No infinite-module proof yet.

claims.name: Ternary degree-three support lower bound 2/9
claims.evidence: Classical Reed-Muller mathematics with an internal recursive Lean proof. The repaired reduced-polynomial foundation is being rebuilt.

claims.name: Teichmuller coordinate phi(a,b)=(a^3+3b) mod 9
claims.evidence: Julia found zero failures over all 81 input pairs, zero cocycle/associativity failures, and an order-nine generator. The naive coordinate failed 36 pairs. Lean source is present; the full build remains the promotion gate.

claims.name: Completed ternary property-(T) counterexample family
claims.evidence: Property-(T), finite generation, ICC, the intrinsic 3^(3n) invariant, topology, crossed products and von Neumann-algebra equivalences remain open.
